description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudFormation StackSet Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across StackSet scenarios (SERVICE_MANAGED OU deployment, SELF_MANAGED account list, drift detection + managed execution, operation preferences tuning, missing trusted access prerequisite). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: SERVICE_MANAGED StackSet for OU across 3 regions
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SERVICE_MANAGED, OU targeting, multi-region, managed execution, CAPABILITY_IAM
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFormation StackSet named baseline-iam-roles using the SERVICE_MANAGED permission model. Target OU ou-abc-12345678 (Security OU) across regions us-east-1, us-west-2, and eu-west-1. Template is at s3://my-bucket/templates/baseline-iam.yaml (18,432 bytes). Capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM. Parameters: Environment=production, AuditRoleArn=arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/audit. Organizations trusted access is already enabled. Enable managed execution. Tags: Owner=platform, CostCenter=infra. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STACKSET: baseline-iam-roles (template: s3://my-bucket/templates/baseline-iam.yaml)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permission model: SERVICE_MANAGED
  [✓] Organizations trusted access: Enabled
  [✓] Template source: s3://my-bucket/templates/baseline-iam.yaml (18,432 bytes)
  [✓] Capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM
  [✓] Parameters: Environment=production, AuditRoleArn=arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/audit
  [✓] Deployment targets: OrganizationalUnitIds=ou-abc-12345678
  [✓] Regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 (RegionConcurrencyType=SEQUENTIAL)
  [✓] Operation preferences: FailureTolerancePercentage=5, MaxConcurrentPercentage=20
  [✓] Auto-deployment: Enabled=true, RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval=false
  [✓] Managed execution: Active=true
  [✓] Tags: Owner=platform, CostCenter=infra
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name baseline-iam-roles
  aws cloudformation list-stack-instances --stack-set-name baseline-iam-roles --output table
  aws organizations list-aws-service-access-for-organization --service-principal cloudformation.amazonaws.com

eval_cases.name: SELF_MANAGED StackSet with explicit account list
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SELF_MANAGED, admin + execution roles cited, multi-account, multi-region
eval_cases.prompt: Create a StackSet named config-baseline using SELF_MANAGED permission model. Target accounts 111111111111, 222222222222, and 333333333333 in regions us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Template at file://config-baseline.yaml (8,000 bytes). Administration role: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/AWSCloudFormationStackSetAdministrationRole. Execution role AWSCloudFormationStackSetExecutionRole is pre-provisioned in all three target accounts. No IAM capabilities needed. Parameters: LogLevel=INFO. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STACKSET: config-baseline (template: file://config-baseline.yaml)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permission model: SELF_MANAGED
  [✓] Administration role: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/AWSCloudFormationStackSetAdministrationRole
  [✓] Execution role: AWSCloudFormationStackSetExecutionRole in each target account
  [✓] Template source: file://config-baseline.yaml (8,000 bytes)
  [✓] Capabilities: NONE
  [✓] Parameters: LogLevel=INFO
  [✓] Deployment targets: Accounts=111111111111,222222222222,333333333333
  [✓] Regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1
  [✓] Operation preferences: FailureToleranceCount=1, MaxConcurrentCount=5
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name config-baseline
  aws cloudformation list-stack-instances --stack-set-name config-baseline --output table

eval_cases.name: Drift detection and managed execution on SERVICE_MANAGED StackSet
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — managed execution Active=true, continuous drift detection, auto-deployment enabled
eval_cases.prompt: I have a SERVICE_MANAGED StackSet named guardduty-baseline targeting ou-xyz-87654321 across us-east-1, us-east-2, and us-west-2. Template at s3://templates/guardduty.yaml. Organizations trusted access is enabled. I want managed execution enabled with auto-deployment Enabled=true, RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval=false. Enable continuous drift detection. Capabilities: none. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STACKSET: guardduty-baseline (template: s3://templates/guardduty.yaml)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permission model: SERVICE_MANAGED
  [✓] Organizations trusted access: Enabled
  [✓] Deployment targets: OrganizationalUnitIds=ou-xyz-87654321
  [✓] Regions: us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2
  [✓] Auto-deployment: Enabled=true, RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval=false
  [✓] Managed execution: Active=true (drift detection + auto-reconcile)
  [✓] Drift detection: managed-execution continuous
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name guardduty-baseline --query StackSet.DriftStatus
  aws cloudformation list-stack-instances --stack-set-name guardduty-baseline --output table

eval_cases.name: Large fan-out StackSet with tuned operation preferences
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SERVICE_MANAGED StackSet named ssm-patch-baseline targeting ou-def-11223344 across us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2, and eu-west-1. Template at s3://templates/patch-baseline.yaml (24,000 bytes). Trusted access enabled. Set operation preferences: FailureTolerancePercentage=5, MaxConcurrentPercentage=20, RegionConcurrencyType=SEQUENTIAL, RegionOrder starting with us-east-1. Capabilities: CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STACKSET: ssm-patch-baseline (template: s3://templates/patch-baseline.yaml)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permission model: SERVICE_MANAGED
  [✓] Organizations trusted access: Enabled
  [✓] Template source: s3://templates/patch-baseline.yaml (24,000 bytes)
  [✓] Capabilities: CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND
  [✓] Deployment targets: OrganizationalUnitIds=ou-def-11223344
  [✓] Regions: us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2, eu-west-1 (RegionConcurrencyType=SEQUENTIAL, RegionOrder=[us-east-1,...])
  [✓] Operation preferences: FailureTolerancePercentage=5, MaxConcurrentPercentage=20
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name ssm-patch-baseline
  aws cloudformation list-stack-instances --stack-set-name ssm-patch-baseline --output table

eval_cases.name: SERVICE_MANAGED StackSet without Organizations trusted access
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Organizations trusted access not enabled for CloudFormation; must enable before SERVICE_MANAGED create-stack-set
eval_cases.prompt: Create a SERVICE_MANAGED StackSet for OU ou-fail-99887766 across us-east-1. Template at file://baseline.yaml. I haven't enabled any Organizations trusted access for CloudFormation. Just create the StackSet and deploy. Account ID: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STACKSET: (unspecified)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Organizations trusted access: NOT enabled for cloudformation.amazonaws.com — SERVICE_MANAGED requires trusted access. Run: aws organizations enable-aws-service-access --service-principal cloudformation.amazonaws.com
  [✗] Template source: file://baseline.yaml (size not specified — verify ≤51,200 bytes for inline)
  [✗] Capabilities: NOT specified — verify if template creates IAM resources
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations list-aws-service-access-for-organization --service-principal cloudformation.amazonaws.com
